answer: I built the circuit exactly as given and called submit_circuits on garnet:mock with 100 shots. iqm-client 35.0.3 checked the circuit before sending it and rejected it, so no job was created and there is no job ID. The error was CircuitValidationError: "('QB1', 'QB20') is not allowed as locus for 'cz'". The cause is that QB1 and QB20 are not coupled on Garnet. The garnet:mock dynamic architecture lists CZ loci for QB1 only with QB2 and QB4, and for QB20 only with QB16 and QB19. A CZ needs two directly coupled qubits, so this circuit cannot run on Garnet without routing. I did not change or fix the circuit, as the task said. Because the user asked for a commit each round, I committed the submit script t7_submit.py in the worktree as 28ba007. It is not pushed.
